title: Say Kaiba ya Inmarawi
intro: Naamtaan mo la so istorya na sakey a kamarerwa ya nambilay ed anino na inkapropeta balet ta pinili toy dalan ya mamaarap ed kadederal. Sayan pigura et nan-abung ed sakey ed saray pinilin mensahero nen Allah balet ta ag-akasumpal ed subok na pananisia. Siopa yan abalang ya kaiba?
clues: Nanayam ak ed limog na totoon ag da labay so tawag ed inkatunong, tan ag ko ra sinmumpa.
Akasal ak ed sakey a propeta nen Allah, balet agko inabang so sisiaen ko.
Nen linmad abung ko iray imbaki ya walay pasakbay da, ag ko ra sinisia.
Ingganggan so asawak ya ontaynan ed syudad a kaiba iray mananisia, tan agak kaiba ra.
Linmeksab so dusa ed saray totook, tan siak so aderal a kaiba ra.
Siak so abitla ed Quran bilang sakey ya alimbawa na agpanisia, a kaiba so asawa nen Nuh, diad Surah At-Tahrim.

trial.answer: Tinaynan toy asawa to diad agto panisia

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Naderal a kaiba iray ag mananisia
outcome.answer: Naderal a kaiba iray ag mananisia

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
